commit_message: Renderer: consume PBR texture inputs in StandardLit
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. Material schema v3 and format-neutral import inputs now flow through runtime texture resolution. Metallic/roughness and occlusion are explicit linear-data slots, normal scale is applied in tangent space, and AO modulates only the StandardLit indirect term while ToonLit and Unlit stay independent.
